```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
```
```kotlin
    }
```

Let me write the helper:
```kotlin
private fun getAllFieldTypes(limeType: LimeType) = getAllFieldTypesRec(getLeafType(limeType), mutableSetOf())

private fun getAllFieldTypesRec(leafType: LimeType, visitedTypes: MutableSet<LimeType>): List<LimeType> {
    if (leafType !is LimeStruct) return listOf(leafType)
    visitedTypes += leafType
    val typesToVisit = leafType.fields.map { getLeafType(it.typeRef.type.actualType) }.distinct() - visitedTypes
    return typesToVisit.flatMap { getAllFieldTypesRec(it, visitedTypes) } + leafType
}

private fun getLeafType(limeType: LimeType): LimeType =
    when (limeType) {
        is LimeTypeAlias -> getLeafType(limeType.typeRef.type)
        is LimeList -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeSet -> getLeafType(limeType.elementType.type)
        is LimeMap -> getLeafType(limeType.valueType.type)
        else -> limeType
    }
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash -e
#

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "${SCRIPT_DIR}/inc.functions"

USAGE=$(cat <<EOF
$0 [options]
    --publish             Build and publish Gluecodium locally and use it for code generation
    --buildGluecodium         Build and use local Gluecodium version
    --gluecodiumPath [PATH]   Implies --buildGluecodium, path to local gluecodium (default: ${GLUECODIUM_PATH})
    --debug               Build with debug symbols
    --help                Print this message
EOF
)

BUILD_LOCAL_GLUECODIUM=false
CMAKE_EXTRA_PARAMETERS=

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --publish)
            publish_local
            shift
            ;;
        --buildGluecodium)
            BUILD_LOCAL_GLUECODIUM=true
            shift
            ;;
        --gluecodiumPath)
            BUILD_LOCAL_GLUECODIUM=true
            GLUECODIUM_PATH="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --debug)
            CMAKE_EXTRA_PARAMETERS="-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo"
            shift
            ;;
        --help|*)
            echo "$USAGE"
            exit 0
            ;;
    esac
done

if [[ "$BUILD_LOCAL_GLUECODIUM" = "true" ]]; then
    export GLUECODIUM_PATH
fi

GLUECODIUM_VERSION="${GLUECODIUM_VERSION:-+}"
BUILD_DIR=${PWD}/build-python
INSTALL_DIR=${PWD}/dist/python

[ -d "${BUILD_DIR}" ] || mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}"
[ -d "${INSTALL_DIR}" ] || mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}"

set -x
CWD=${PWD}
pushd "${BUILD_DIR}"

tmppipe=$(mktemp -u)
mkfifo -m 600 "$tmppipe"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmppipe"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
tee cmake_output.log < "$tmppipe" &
safe cmake \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="$(which clang)" \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$(which clang++)" \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="${INSTALL_DIR}" \
    -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON \
    -DGLUECODIUM_GENERATORS_DEFAULT="cpp;python" \
    -DGLUECODIUM_VERSION_DEFAULT="${GLUECODIUM_VERSION}" \
    -DFUNCTIONAL_BUILD_PYTHON_TESTS=ON \
    -G Ninja \
    ${CMAKE_EXTRA_PARAMETERS} \
    .. > "$tmppipe"
popd

safe cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}"
```

## Continuation session

Ran the `field_constructors` pytest directly (`PYTHONPATH` pointed at the
built `functional` extension, using Python 3.14 since the `.so` is built for
`cpython-314`): **26 passed, 3 failed**. All three were real generator bugs,
not harness issues.

### Failure 1 — missing default constructor for `FieldConstructorsPartialDefaults`

The Python `hasDefaultConstructor` predicate (`PythonGeneratorPredicates.kt`)
required *all* fields to have defaults, which is stricter than C++. The C++
predicate (`CppGeneratorPredicates.kt`) allows a default constructor as long
as no field constructor is empty and no uninitialized field is immutable, even
if some uninitialized fields have no Lime default (they just get
default-initialized, e.g. `""`/`0`). Rewrote the Python predicate to mirror
C++ exactly (reusing `CommonGeneratorPredicates.getAllFieldTypes`, promoted
from `private` to `internal`). This also exposed a bug in the hand-written
functional test (`field_constructors_test.py`), which wrongly expected the
Lime-default values `"nonsense"`/`42` instead of the C++ default-ctor values
`""`/`0`.

### Failures 2 & 3 — wrapper `__init__` couldn't accept native pybind11 objects

`PythonStruct.mustache`'s `__init__` only recognized *wrapper* objects (via
`hasattr(args[0], "_native")`). Static factories (e.g. `create_me`) and
property getters for nested structs return **native** pybind11 objects
directly, which don't have `_native`, so construction fell through to the
"unwrap and re-invoke the native ctor" branch and failed since the native type
often has no matching overload (e.g. a copy-style call).

Fixed by checking `isinstance(args[0], <nativeModule>.<Type>)` first, and
removed the (now redundant and actually harmful) `hasattr(... "_native")`
branch. It did the wrong thing when passed a wrapper of a **different**
struct type: it would grab that wrapper's `_native` and hand it straight to
`_NativeBase.__init__`, bypassing the native constructor's field copying
entirely, breaking `OuterStructWithFieldConstructor(inner_wrapper)`.

### Verification

- Rebuilt via `functional-tests/scripts/build-python-functional --publish`
  (publishes the local Gluecodium build and regenerates + recompiles the
  functional pybind11 extension). Had to touch the `.lime` input to force
  CMake to re-run code generation after template/generator changes.
- `field_constructors_test.py`: **29 passed, 0 failed**.
- Gluecodium smoke test for `field_constructors` (`./gradlew :gluecodium:test
  --tests "*FieldConstructors*"`): BUILD SUCCESSFUL, goldens back in sync.
- Spot-checked other Python functional test files for regressions from the
  `hasDefaultConstructor`/`__init__` changes: `classes_test.py` and
  `enums_test.py` pass. `structs_test.py::test_colored_line` fails, but this is
  a **pre-existing, unrelated bug**: a second `needsAllFieldsConstructor`
  definition in `PythonGeneratorPredicates.kt` shadows the first (Kotlin
  `mapOf` keeps the later entry) and incorrectly suppresses the all-fields
  constructor whenever `uninitializedFields.isEmpty()`, unlike C++. `Color`
  (all fields defaulted) is unaffected by this session's `hasDefaultConstructor`
  fix either way. Left as a follow-up, not part of B4.

B4 (FieldConstructors) is now complete and verified.
DOCEOF

```bash
commit f981e055b768717ba328baabc1328568b62c419f
Author: Ming Li <ming.5.li@here.com>
Date:   Fri Jul 17 15:27:13 2026 +0200

    Fix Python pybind11 field constructor binding (B4)
    
    - hasDefaultConstructor predicate now mirrors the C++ generator: a
      default constructor is emitted unless there's an empty field
      constructor or an uninitialized immutable field, even when some
      uninitialized fields lack a Lime default.
    - PythonStruct __init__ now recognizes native pybind11 objects
      (isinstance check) so static factories and nested-struct property
      getters construct correctly; the previous hasattr(_native) branch
      was removed since it bypassed the native constructor when passed a
      wrapper of a different struct type.
    - Regenerated field_constructors Python smoke goldens.
    - Fixed a wrong expectation in the functional pytest
      (FieldConstructorsPartialDefaults default ctor gives ""/0, not
      the Lime defaults from an unrelated struct).
    [?2004h
```

Nested structs SelfHolder/NotNullSelfHolder each have a field (mySelf)
pointing back to their own enclosing class InstanceInStruct. Since
nested Lime types flatten into separate top-level Python modules,
InstanceInStruct.py needed 'from ...SelfHolder import SelfHolder' for
its factory return types, while SelfHolder.py needed 'from
...InstanceInStruct import InstanceInStruct' for the mySelf getter -
an unresolvable circular import at module load time.

Added an isAncestorField predicate (PythonGeneratorPredicates.kt) that
detects a field whose type is one of its own container's ancestors,
and a resolveReferenceName method on PythonNameResolver to compute the
module path. PythonGenerator excludes that module from the file's
top-level imports, and PythonField.mustache emits a local (deferred)
import inside the property getter body instead, resolved only when the
getter is called (by which point both modules exist).

Verified: new instance_in_struct_test.py passes 3/3. Gluecodium smoke
test suite has the same 38 pre-existing Python failures before and
after (bisected via git stash) - no regressions." 2>&1 | tail -10
